dataset_name: HAM10000 (Human Against Machine with 10000 training images)
publisher: Harvard Dataverse / ViDIR Group, Medical University of Vienna

bkl.full_name: Benign keratosis-like lesions (solar lentigines / seborrheic keratoses)

known_limitations: Heavily imbalanced in favor of melanocytic nevi (67%).
Derived from Caucasian cohorts; lack of validated representation across Fitzpatrick IV-VI skin types.
Valid only on dermatoscopic lens imaging; uncalibrated smartphone camera photos exhibit severe domain shift.
